registeredBefore: Committed before qualify.py ran on any fetched series. Seen so far: only the run summary of smoke batch 5 (counts: 288 requested, 287 with prices, 576 requests, all HTTP 200) and the provider meta header of one control ticker.

clarifications.C1_last_traded_bar: Trailing daily bars with volume 0 or null are dropped before R1-R7 (the provider keeps some delisted listings with frozen bars; V10 lifecycle convention). 'Last bar' in R1/R3/R6 means the last traded bar.
clarifications.C2_weeks: ISO week = Monday-based calendar week; weekly close = split-adjusted close of the last traded bar in that week; total-return variant from provider adjClose (dividends included) of the same bar.
clarifications.C3_split_adjustment: split-adjusted close(t) = close(t) / product of splitFactor over all later bars.
clarifications.C4_reason_mapping: V12 delisting-reasons labels are mapped as: MERGER_ACQUISITION_COMPLETED -> MERGER; BANKRUPTCY -> DISTRESS; any other label (incl. MERGER_PROCESS_INDICATED) -> DISTRESS if last raw close < 1 USD else UNKNOWN. This equals R6 (2.01 / 1.03) on the label set V12 actually produced.
clarifications.C5_public_redaction: Public register rows use the V12 LISTREF keyed chain id (scripts/quant/v12/listref/redact.cjs#chainId), CIK and 5-year buckets only.
